findings.mechanism: enqueue() links every attempt record to the previous one (record.previous = this.latest; this.latest = record). The shared, process-lifetime scheduler keeps `latest`, so the whole backward chain of every attempt record ever created stays reachable. PendingList.unlink() only clears node.next, never node.previous, and nothing ever truncates the chain. Each record holds its job, and each job holds its payload rows, so completed jobs are never collected even though pending is empty and inflight is 0. recent() only needs 10 entries.
findings.cause: unbounded back-pointer chain (audit trail) rooted at scheduler.latest on a singleton scheduler
findings.evidence: Ran 6 consecutive batches of runWorkload(20000) with forced gc: heapUsed rose 85.0, 166.6, 248.1, 329.5, 410.9, 492.4 MB while pending=0, inflight=0. Walking latest->previous gave a chain of 29292, 58584, ... 175752 records, growing by about 29k per batch, which equals the number of attempts.
findings.discriminator: Fix: bound the trail, e.g. cap its length or drop record.previous when the record is unlinked/run, or keep a ring buffer of 10 summaries instead of the records.

findings.mechanism: deadLetters array is appended on each give-up.
findings.evidence: push is followed by shift once length exceeds DEAD_LETTER_LIMIT (100), so it stays at most 100 entries of small {id,status} objects. In the run above dead=0.
findings.discriminator: Length is bounded at 100 by the shift.

findings.mechanism: inflight Map keyed by job id.
findings.cause: entries deleted on both the delivered and dead paths
findings.discriminator: inflight.size == 0 after each batch; both terminal paths call inflight.delete.

findings.mechanism: sharedScheduler singleton keeps the first clock and endpoint forever.
findings.cause: a single fixed-size object by design
findings.evidence: Only one scheduler, clock and endpoint exist across all batches. Endpoint holds just a counter. It is the root through which the leak above is reachable, not a growth source itself.
findings.discriminator: Its own state is constant-size, and pending is a properly unlinked list (length 0).
